verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.jitsu.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary, which is exactly what an agent can be pointed at. Docs pages are also served as Markdown (.md) variants, such as the MCP, API, CLI, webhook, and HTML-snippet pages, giving agents clean, machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-docs offering and its coverage (e.g., an llms-full.txt), and independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
